lines.en: I carry a tray past the long table.

lines.zh: 木地板在我脚下吱吱响。
lines.en: The floorboards creak under me.
I wipe cups as I move.
I squeeze between two drunks.
I lift the tray so nothing spills.
I walk to the kitchen door.
My apron string has come loose.
I pass the ale barrels.
I climb a stool to reach the shelf.
The tavern's smoke makes me squint.
My short heels clack on the boards.
I weave between the tables.
I count empty cups as I go.
I push a chair back into place.
I step behind the bar.
I raise a hand against the smoke.
I wipe a cup, then wipe it again.
I count the coins in the pouch.
My pointed ears stay tuned for talk.
I add a log to the stove.
One barrel is leaking.
I glance at the bell above the door.
I straighten the stools one by one.
I sniff the new brew.
My cap brim shadows my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把最后一盏灯点上了。
lines.en: I light the last lamp.
I hang the rag on the barrel's rim.
The stove heat reddens my face.

lines.zh: 我撑着吧台发了一会儿呆。
lines.en: I lean on the bar and stare a while.
I hum a tune off key.
I tap a barrel with a nail.
I reckon this week's takings.
Sit down, don't stand about.
I haven't seen your face before.
What will you have?

lines.zh: 你那身衣服不像本地人。
lines.en: That outfit isn't local.
Have you brought coin?
Pay first, then I pour.
Keep your hands off my cups.
Keep it down, guests upstairs.
Inside or by the door?
I know those boots.
This place isn't safe.
Best not start trouble.
My apron is soiled.
You knocked over my ale.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我的围裙带子打断了。
lines.en: That blow snapped my apron strings.
I'll remember this bill.

lines.zh: 帽子滚进吧台底下，我够不着。
lines.en: My hat rolled under the bar, out of reach.
I step back and grip the bar.
This won't stop me pouring.
I steady myself against the barrel.
Don't wreck the shop.
You will be paying for that.
That mushroom buys a drink.
Nice colour on that.
Put it on the bar, let me look.
Is that coin in your hand?
That's a low price.
I take coin, not favours.

lines.zh: 再添一点，我多给你一壶。
lines.en: Add a bit more, I'll pour extra.
You carry a strange mix.
That won't quite buy a drink.
Sit, let me mix you something.
Steady that hand, it'll spill.
I'll take this.
This smells a bit like medicine.
Where did you get it?
Enough for two mild ones.
Easy, I have to weigh it.
Mind my tray.
Spilled it, that's on your tab.

lines.zh: 我的托盘歪了，杯子全响。
lines.en: My tray tilts; every glass rattles.
A short frame like mine doesn't take knocks.
Step aside, I'm working.
You're standing on my apron.
The cup nearly dropped.
Don't jostle things in this place.
I'll shift a little, go on.
Bump me again and you're out.
I can't leave this bar.
I have guests to serve.
That waits until closing.
I don't discuss that with customers.
Order a drink first.
My ears are sharp, I hear it all.
The walls here have ears.
I'm more interested in ale.
You've had too much.
Come back after closing.
A coin, dropped on the floor.
I pick it up and blow the dust off.
Whose cup is this?
I take the empty bottle to the shelf.
A splinter of wood on the floor.
I sweep it aside.
You dropped it, I'm keeping it.
This rag still works.
I feel something under the table.
Save it, it'll fetch something.
Starting trouble, are you?
I set the cup down.
This place has rules.
I reach for the club under the bar.
But I know how to handle you.
Your hand is at your belt.
The door is that way.
Don't smash my barrels.
One shout and the back room comes.
Last time: sit down.
I've come out from behind the bar.

lines.zh: 我的围裙后头塞着东西。
lines.en: There's something under my apron.
The patrons are backing away.
You haven't finished your drink.
I'm shorter, but not scared.
Floor's slick, watch your step.
I count from three.
One drink for one of your coins.
You're a stubborn one.
Don't blame me then.
I smack your hand with the tray.
I hop off a stool at you.
That landed on your belly.
I shove you toward the door.
My fists are small, but quick.
A bottle broke, what a waste.
You tripped on your own feet.
Back off, don't break things.

lines.zh: 我用酒瓶敲你，然后退到桶后。
lines.en: I crack a bottle on you and duck behind the kegs.
This round's on me.
I push the door and the bell rings.
The tavern opens today.
I roll in a fresh barrel.
The stove is already lit.
I snap a rag over my shoulder.
The stools are wiped clean.
I turn the sign to open.
The smell of ale reaches the street.
My customers are late.
A busy night ahead.
Fire caught my cuff.

lines.zh: 我从凳上摔下来，砸了一地。
lines.en: I fall off the stool in a clatter.

lines.zh: 酒桶翻了，我被淹在里面。
lines.en: A barrel tipped and I'm soaked in it.
The blast flips every table.
That stuck in my bar.
Magic passes and the ale sours.

lines.zh: 空着肚子招呼不了客人。
lines.en: I can't serve on an empty stomach.
Lightning hits and every cup shatters.
No bar to tend in the void.
